description: Add items to an existing asset set (from generate_asset_set), reusing everything it was made with: its view, style preset, style words, palette and style sheet. Or redraw_failed: true draws again, on a small sheet in the same style, just the pieces that failed their view check or were not cut out. Same price: 20 a sheet + 10 a cut; estimate_only shows it first. New pieces get world_height in the same reference character's heights (give `size` for each new item whose size matters: a new sheet has no reference character on it to measure against).

estimate_only.description: true = only the plan and the price; nothing is drawn or charged

body.description: Characters: body plan (a wolf is quadruped, a slime blob, a bat flying). Omitted: guessed

kind.description: character (rotated and animated), object (a prop) or tile. Omitted: guessed from the name

name.description: What it is, e.g. 'knight', 'ice golem', 'treasure chest'

notes.description: Optional details: colours, outfit, what it holds

reference.description: This item is the set's unit of height (default: the first humanoid character)

shape.description: Optional: how it fits a cell (a tree is tall, a cart wide). Omitted: guessed

size.description: Its height in the game world, as a multiple of the set's reference character (the hero = 1): a boss golem 2.5, a slime 0.5, a door 1.2. Wins over the height the sheet draws (sheets often draw a boss barely bigger than the hero). Give it whenever relative size matters

redraw_failed.description: Also redraw the set's pieces that failed the view check or went missing

set_id.description: The set's id (generate_asset_set's set_id: its first sheet's asset id)

name: add_to_asset_set
